title: Genetic architecture and inheritance patterns of Leber hereditary optic neuropathy among 419 Chinese pedigrees carrying the ND4 11778G>A mutation.
intervention: No pharmacological intervention; genetic and clinical analysis of m.11778G>A pedigrees

outcomes.name: Inheritance/transmission pattern
outcomes.effect_text: sporadic, maternal and complex transmission patterns; 209 pedigrees with single affected individuals

outcomes.name: Disease penetrance (mitochondrial haplogroup)
outcomes.effect_text: Haplogroups D4j, M7, M9, M10 significantly enriched in maternally inherited families with elevated disease penetrance
